aiReview.method: All source paragraphs, lesson metadata, prompts, options, option-specific reasons, effective readingJa and figureCaptionsJa compared directly against the canonical Japanese packet. Exact repeated Japanese definitions may reuse this translator’s previously authored zh-CN definitions; no other language translation is an input.
aiReview.register: Respectful adult 您, stable original Japanese character names, no inferred age/gender/kinship. Original Japanese headwords/readings retained as vocabulary learning targets; definitions translated.
specificChecks: ADL/IADL, movement vs transfer, posture names and actual stability remain distinct.
Explanation and consent, individual-plan/training/needed-personnel conditions retained; no angle, threshold, invented medical intervention or universal transfer procedure added.
Bed working height vs feet-supported edge sitting; turning vs rising vs standing; weakness, dizziness and pain conditions retained.
Wheelchair parking brake vs attendant brake, tire condition, foot support vs step platform, routes and conditional curb/slope examples retained.
Cane two/three-step and upstairs/downstairs limb/cane order preserved with original conditional scope.
13:40 room access vs14:00 start;13:55 pause;14:05 communication vs14:30 participation cutoff;latest14:20 start;13:05 assembly vs13:20 departure preserved.

Current wish not to attend vs all-day absence; conditional later participation vs decided attendance; unconfirmed pain/breathlessness vs absent symptoms; announced correction vs already corrected preserved.
Guide announces contact/direction/environment changes before action; no sudden wrist pull, push or silent handover.
All three technical diagram captions translated with exact keys and explicit pending Japanese-label status.

limits: AI direct bilingual editorial comparison only; no independent human, native-speaker, professional, rights or release approval.
Paragraph records and repeated reference strings are not unique source concepts; no whole-book coverage percentage claimed.
Technical illustration assets still have old Vietnamese labels, as Japanese source captions explicitly state. Only captions translated; no image localization or device verification claimed.
No runtime integration, UI modification, source master/question edit or commit by this translator.
